name: design-studio
description: Design in the browser, decide with real components, source from registries. /design-studio:init opens a design session — chat, select, drag, resize, edit text and pick colours on HTML prototypes or your running dev server, with this Claude Code session applying every gesture to real files and live-reloading; skins show one wireframe in the feel of shadcn, Bootstrap, MUI or Astryx (lookalikes, never the library); /design-studio:export writes tokens, pages and a brief. /design-studio:preview renders 2-3 variants with the project's OWN components on its dev server, consent-gated, cleaned up after. Two MCP servers read the Aceternity, shadcn, Magic UI and ReUI registries live, never from memory.
